verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at developers.clara.team (HTTP 200) and markdown docs pages that point agents back to the llms.txt index. The docs also advertise an LLM-optimized /llms-api.txt API reference, a dedicated agent-instructions page with guidance on money-moving operations, and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema for function calling. Missing for 10: no probe confirming /llms-api.txt is actually served, and no independent or community report of agents successfully consuming these docs.
